theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_af_adjoint_det_eq_gram
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (B : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (σ : Fin k → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ σ → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range σ) = T → ((B.comp T.subtypeL).adjoint ∘L (B.comp T.subtypeL)).det = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin k => inner ℝ (B (σ i)) (B (σ j)))
